correctness.rationale: For rooted P_(t,s) with t>=1 length-two arms and s>=0 leaves, each nonempty downset corresponds to t independent three-state arm coordinates and s binary coordinates; including empty gives |J|=1+3^t2^s. Maximum antichain consists of b_i,c_j so VC=t+s. The nonempty subfamily has Littlestone rank t+s by disjoint-product additivity of the exact mistake-tree recursion. Adding the empty hypothesis raises rank by at most one. Query at a lower arm point has positive branch rank t+s and negative branch is J_(t-1,s); root, upper arm and leaf queries cannot cause an extra round. Induction with auxiliary t=0 cases proves Ldim=t+1 for s=0 and t+s for s>=1. Independent direct downset and mistake-tree exhaustive recurrence verified small parameter cases: THREE_LDIM_EXACT_PASS. Infinite t,s follow induction, not finite search.
